children: Ryanair Holdings will take a margin hit from an increase in jet fuel prices, but the company can continue to prosper over the medium term thanks to its low cost base and strong balance sheet, Davy Research's Stephen Furlong and Ava Costello say in a research note. While its outlook is clouded by fuel, the Irish budget-carrier group could endure some short-term pain for the long-term gain, the analysts say. "If anything, the current dislocation in the market could make medium-term targets more achievable," they add. Shares rise 1.8%. (adria.calatayud@wsj.com)
